I visited Sikkim's restricted valley called Dzongu Valley
It felt like a place I had to slowly experience through its forests, rivers, homes, food, stories, silences, and the people who have protected its identity for generations.
Hidden in North Sikkim, Dzongu Valley is the homeland of the Lepcha community, one of Sikkim’s disappearing indigenous communities. It is a region where nature is not just scenery, but a part of everyday life.
